inspiration: FareedKhan-dev/train-llm-from-scratch: end-to-end data-to-generation and post-training stages

phases.purpose: Collect a small legal/local text dataset, inspect size, duplicates and format.
Start with an existing tokenizer or tiny educational BPE experiment before any expensive run.
phases.nova_check: confirm vocab size and sample encoding/decoding

phases.purpose: Use a tiny GPT-style config first, then scale only after loss curves and generation smoke tests behave.
Train on a tiny slice only to prove dataloader, checkpoints, resume, logging and generation work.
phases.nova_check: save loss, sample output and checkpoint hash

phases.purpose: Prefer SFT or task-specific finetuning for usefulness; avoid expensive from-scratch unless educational.
phases.nova_check: hold out eval prompts and regression tests

phases.purpose: Run deterministic prompt tests, safety checks, hallucination checks and code/file task checks before routing into Nova.
Use the trained model only for roles it passes; keep fallback to the proven chat/code model.

guardrails: Do not train on private chats, secrets, API keys, passwords or copyrighted dumps you do not have rights to use.
Do not let training scripts overwrite Nova source or release files; run in a separate experiments folder.
Keep the first run tiny and checkpointed; expensive runs need explicit confirmation and host evidence.
Treat from-scratch models as educational unless evaluation proves they beat your existing Ollama models for a specific Nova role.

estimate.recommendation: Feasible for an educational tiny/small from-scratch run on a 16GB GPU if code is efficient and batch size is small.
